correctness.rationale: The exact model K*=L+K_(n-L) with L binomial and K_r uniform permutation fixed points yields three limits. If ntheta→lambda then L→Pois(lambda) TV and R→∞, whence K_R→Pois(1) in conditional TV, giving Pois(1+lambda). If n(1-theta)→mu then unresolved R→Pois(mu) TV and applying the fixed moved-point kernel gives P(W_mu=d)=e^-mu D_d/d! sum_(j>=0) mu^(d+j)/[(d+j)! j!]; D_1=0. If both endpoint intensities diverge, binomial variance diverges, residual K_R is tight (mean≤1), and the stated exact-mean centered CLT follows by Slutsky. Independent exact finite convolutions, impossible n-1 match and mixture check pass. The proof—not those finite checks—covers all parameter arrays meeting conditions.
residual_risks: Finite experiments and exact checks do not alone establish infinite/uniform quantifiers; proof reconstructed from original RESULT.md.
